correctness.rationale: The nested dyadic model is finite and explicit. Direct shell integration gives the stated Fujii-Wilson A_infinity characteristic, v=M_D omega makes the mixed A1 characteristic exactly one, and testing f=1 on the deepest interval yields a weak-L1 norm ratio of order N^(1/r-1). The interval cases and strict weak-level threshold were checked separately.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The inspected arXiv:2609.20531v1 proves the p=1, 0<r<1 upper estimate and calls this range new even dyadically, but its sharpness discussion concerns neighboring cases and no matching lower-bound example was found. Exact and synonymous searches, plus the current SCOPE archive, found no prior statement isolating the A_infinity exponent while keeping the mixed A1 characteristic equal to one. The source is extremely recent, so unindexed contemporaneous observations remain the main residual risk.

value.rationale: The result determines that the new endpoint A_infinity exponent 1/r-1 is intrinsic rather than a proof loss. Holding the mixed A1 characteristic identically equal to one cleanly separates the two factors and gives a reusable finite sharpness example.
